[color=#00ff00][size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
Just unzip the downloaded file into your Mods folder.


[color=#00ff00][size=6][b]How trigger the animation?[/b][/size][/color]
Stand to the right or left of the girl/boy and click to talk, when the NPC is idle. When the conversation ends, the animation starts on the next click.

Not compatible with custom kissing mod, as it override the same action. 
 
Compatible with "Nude Mode for 1.4" mod

[color=#00ff00][size=6][b]Config options[/b][/size][/color]
Run the game once with the mod installed, it will create a file named config.json 
In the MOD folder, open it (or change the options in GenericModConfigMenu if you have it)
[list]
[*]DisableDatingRequirement: if changed to true, the NPC doesn't have to be your girlfriend (or spouse) to make sex with.
[*]RequiredFriendshipLevel: level of the friendship needed to make sex, defaults to 8.
[*]EndingDIalogue: you can disable the line of dialogue after sex.
[/list]

[color=#00ff00][size=6][b]Make sex with other NPCs?
[/b][/size][/color]Currently only the datable girls and boys are set to make love with.

But you can create your own Content Pack Mod for use with this mod to allow any existent NPC to make sex with, or even replace the sprites from an existing NPC.
In the mod folders, there's a "ContentPackTemplate" folder with an example of the files needed. It's a functional CP for making love with Jodi. Just copy it to your mod's folder and mark "DisableDatingRequirement" for it to work.
